1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube at a specific location that enables reading of the MTP through the test tube material.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube __with a frost-coated or translucent layer overlying the MTP__.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, __with the MTP oriented for reading downwards through the bottom surface__.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube __designed for long-term storage of biological samples at reduced temperatures__.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in __a plastic material comprising__ polypropylene or acetal polymer.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the __test tube__.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 __wherein the system is__ adapted for low temperature operation, such that the racks/test tubes are handled at -20 C or less __during sample storage and retrieval operations__.
